AttributeList.Text:
// This program simulates a hydraulic press system with safety chocks that hold the platen up. It is designed to teach how proximity sensors work as safety interlocks. The proximity sensor input (I6) verifies that the chocks are physically engaged before allowing the motors/pumps to turn off.
The proxy sits inside the press chocks and when the chocks are extended, the proxy detects the press platan and the plc knows the press is locked up and the motors can be turned off.
The chocks will not be extended unless the platan is in position, at 15000mm.
Once the chocks are extended and the platan locked up, the press is now considered to be in a safe state.
Once the user starts this worksheet/program 6,the motors will start spinning at 50% (idle), and the press platan will be on the base of the press. The user will have to click Raise, to lift the press up. Motors "under load" will spin at 100%. Then at 15000mm, the Lock button will be enabled.
Once Lock is pressed, chocks will extend and extending will be shown until the user puts metal infront of the proximity sensor.
At this point the motor will go back to idle. And the Stop button will be enabled, for the user to stop the program. A message will then be displayed saying Press In Safe Locked Position.
The proxy sits inside the press chocks and when the chocks are extended, the proxy detects the press platan and the plc knows the press is locked up and the motors can be turned off.
